subject: Proposal: Keynote-for-Lounge visibility swap + SOW
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena@techstageconf.com>
To: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-11-16T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposal: Keynote-for-Lounge visibility swap + SOW

Hi Kimberly,

Great speaking with you yesterday — appreciate the candid feedback on package placement. Per our call, I attached the sponsor package (v3.1) and the latest floorplan. The quick proposal:

- Redwood keeps a 15-minute keynote slot (Day 2, AM) but we upgrade your lounge footprint to the Premium Lounge (larger footprint, dedicated AV, branded bar).
- You get front-stage logo placement on the venue hero banner and priority logo in the mobile app carousel.
- We’ll provide 6 exhibitor badges + 2 VIP speaker badges (for the keynote).
- AV tech support (2 technicians, 4 mic passes) and a dedicated Wi‑Fi SSID for demo traffic are included.

If that sounds right, I’ll send a SOW with the revised deliverables and a DocuSign link by EOD tomorrow. We’ll need confirmation of logo files (SVG + PNG) and the speaker bio by Nov 20 to lock placements.

Quick ask on the contract side — any standard vendor addenda or CLA we should expect from Redwood? If so, send it over and I’ll loop Legal.

Thanks — excited to get Redwood more visible on the main floor.

Best,
Elena Torres
Director, Sponsorships
TechStage Conference
attachments: TechStage_Sponsor_Package_3.1.pdf, TechStage_Floorplan_v4.png

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Torres <elena@techstageconf.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: Keynote-for-Lounge visibility swap + SOW

Hi Elena — thanks, this is promising. A few points from our side:

- We’re open to the swap (keynote for Premium Lounge upgrade) if the lounge guarantees a dedicated demo power circuit and 1Gbps sustained Wi‑Fi per table. Demo stability is non‑negotiable.
- We’d like logo prominence on the left side of the hero banner (near main entrance) and an in-session slide template that includes Redwood logo for the keynote slides.
- Can you confirm AV hours covered for setup (vendor load-in window) and whether a backstage cart is available for live demo machines?
- We also need an exhibitor meeting with your AV lead to share codec/port requirements.

Two asks on timing: we need DocuSign by Nov 18 to route through our procurement and get travel approval for the speaker. Also please add a clause that allows for a single contingency change (fallback model or pre-record) if there are show-day capacity constraints.

Looping in Marissa and Aditya to confirm ops and creative. If Legal needs to redline the SOW, we’ll push back within 48 hours.

Thanks — KP

--
Kimberly Park
Head of Field Marketing 
Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0186

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-16T11:18:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Proposal: Keynote-for-Lounge visibility swap + SOW

Marissa / Aditya — quick internal note before I send the accept:

- Must-haves for us: dedicated power circuit (30A), sustained 1Gbps per table, left-side hero placement on entrance banner, in-session slide template with logo lockup. If any of these are no-go, we ask for additional paid logo real estate or a compensated upsell.
- AV budget: we should cover one extra tech if their proposal doesn’t include encoder support for live demos. Plan $1,200 buffer.
- Speaker logistics: one speaker + one demo engineer travel; travel approval contingent on DocuSign in by 11/18.
- Legal: ask Legal to pre-clear the standard sponsor addendum — I’ll forward redlines if they come back.

Marissa — can you own exhibitor ops (badges, load-in schedule, booth build specs)? Aditya — can you confirm we have an internal playbook for on-site demo failover (pre-record + local playback)?

I’ll tell Elena we accept the swap contingent on the above and ask for the SOW link.

KP

>

Hi Kimberly — thanks for the clear notes. We’ve updated the SOW and floorplan:

- Dedicated 30A power circuit committed to your lounge island (circuit ID: L-230).
- Venue will reserve a 1Gbps managed VLAN for your demo subnet; SSID and auth details to be provided 2 weeks out.
- Hero banner placement confirmed — left side near main entrance (attachment shows placement).
- Speaker slide template: included as an addendum to the SOW.
- Backstage cart and encoder support: available on request (we added one encoder and rack space in the SOW).

I attached the redlined SOW and the updated floorplan. Please review and sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/tx/ABC123def. We can also push AV contact details for a 30-minute tech sync next Tue.

Attachments: TechStage_SOW_redlines.docx, TechStage_Floorplan_v4.png

Elena / Sponsorship Ops — thank you, that addresses our must-haves. We have reviewed the redlined SOW and confirm:

- Accept the dedicated L-230 30A circuit and the managed 1Gbps VLAN.
- Hero banner placement confirmed (left / main entrance).
- We will sign the DocuSign today; aiming to complete routing by EOD so procurement can release travel.

Two final items before signature: please send logo spec (SVG, 300dpi PNG) and max safe area dimensions for the hero banner, and confirm exhibitor badge names (we will submit badge names once DocuSign is complete). Also confirm whether the keynote will be scheduled at 11:00 AM on Day 2 (we’ll lock speaker travel around that).

We look forward to the AV tech sync next Tue; Marissa will coordinate times.

Thanks — KP
